set.body: Implement radius-neighborhood and geodesic distance APIs over MeshTopology: DistanceMetric enum (Euclidean, Geodesic, Spherical), Dijkstra over weighted edges, source/target subsets, chunked distance matrix, and explicit cache policy object. Acceptance: tetrahedron distances match neurosurf expectations, spherical distances clamp trigonometry to avoid NaN, invalid vertices/radius/weights fail clearly, and JVM/JS tests pass. Likely paths: modules/surface/shared/src/main/scala/scalafim/surface/geodesic, modules/surface/shared/src/test/scala/scalafim/surface.
set.title: Neighborhood and geodesic query engine
